description: This file defines a custom annotation interface 'ConfigureInstanceMode' used in integration tests to configure different modes of an instance, controlling read, write, batch worker, and batch manager enablement.

methods.name: readEnabled
methods.description: Method in annotation to specify if reading is enabled in the instance mode.

methods.name: writeEnabled
methods.description: Method in annotation to specify if writing is enabled in the instance mode.

methods.name: batchWorkerEnabled
methods.description: Method in annotation to specify if the batch worker is enabled.

methods.name: batchManagerEnabled
methods.description: Method in annotation to specify if the batch manager is enabled.
